edition: v1.1 reference edition - Level 0 accuracy audit

0.1_area_reconciliation.summary: Albers (published) vs Turf.js (independent) agree to 0.000% at province level, 0.001% max at district level. Area computation method is sound.
0.1_area_reconciliation.gap_explanation: 0.4-0.5% gap vs official is consistent with 5% generalised geometry. Documented.
0.1_area_reconciliation.lhulier_note: L'Huilier spherical triangle decomposition gave 317,622 km² (wrong) due to triangle decomposition issues with large non-convex polygons. Not a real problem - Turf and Albers agree.

real_interior_overlaps.verdict: PASS (9 false positives from sampling method; grid-based intersection area = 0.00 km² for all)

gaps.verdict: EXPECTED (4 protected areas with no local-level data)

containment_note.detail: Darchula district centroid not in Sudurpashchim province polygon. 419/1034 vertices outside province. Label point IS inside. Root cause: simplified province boundary does not perfectly contain the simplified district boundary. Not a data error - generalisation artifact.

0.7_peak_coordinate_audit.key_finding: 47/51 peaks from Wikidata (S04). Single-source dominance. Multi-source verification not possible with current data.
0.7_peak_coordinate_audit.recommendation: Obtain coordinates from at least 2 independent sources per peak for v1.2. Priority: peaks with review_flags (border summits outside simplified polygons).

overall_verdict: Level 0 audit: 0.1 PASS, 0.2 PASS (1 documented note), 0.7 WARN (single-source dominance for peaks). No blocking issues for v1.1 release. Peak coordinate multi-source verification deferred to v1.2.
